typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		RPT_DT as timestamp,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		CREATE_DTTM as timestamp,
		LAST_UPD_DTTM as timestamp,
		LAST_ALTER_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DCL_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DDL_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DML_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DQL_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT as timestamp,
		USERNAME as string,
		USER_FULL_NAME as string,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		USER_ROLE_LIST as string,
		EMP_ID as string,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT RPT_DT       ,PLTFM_TXT       ,ENVRN_TXT       ,DATABASENAME       ,CREATE_DTTM       ,LAST_UPD_DTTM       ,LAST_ALTER_DT       ,LAST_DCL_DT       ,LAST_DDL_DT       ,LAST_DML_DT       ,LAST_DQL_DT       ,LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT       ,USERNAME       ,USER_FULL_NAME       ,USER_EMAIL_ADDR       ,USER_ROLE_LIST       ,EMP_ID       ,LAST_ACCESS_DT   FROM SBXAPP.RPT_INACTIVE_USERS  /* WHERE CREATE_DTTM  BETWEEN  TRUNC(SYSDATE, \'MM\') and TRUNC(SYSDATE,\'DD\') */ WHERE RPT_DT > ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(TO_DATE(SYSDATE), \'MM\'), -3)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		sandbox_name as string,
		platform_name as string,
		environment_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select sandbox_name 	, platform_name 	, environment_name from ESIMS_ETL.sbx.tbl_sas_master_list where IsActive = 1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(ENVRN_TXT == environment_name && DATABASENAME == sandbox_name,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		USER_FULL_NAME as string,
		USER_ROLE_LIST as string,
		USER_EMP_ID as string,
		RPT_DT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		USERNAME as string,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT as string,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ENVRN_TXT,
		USER_FULL_NAME,
		USER_ROLE_LIST,
		USER_EMP_ID = EMP_ID,
		RPT_DT,
		DATABASENAME,
		USERNAME,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR)) ~> OLEDBDestination
